# NFL Daily — 2026-11-04 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Ravens are finalizing a trade for QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals as Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley both remain out; the deal won't be done in time for Thursday's game at Jacksonville. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50381318/sources-ravens-finalizing-trade-cardinals-qb-brissett)
- Browns are turning to rookie QB Shedeur Sanders for Sunday at New Orleans after Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50378819/browns-qb-watson-concussion-protocol-status-vs-saints-unclear)
- Eagles are benching Tanner McKee for Joe Milton against the Giants — the fourth different QB to throw for Philadelphia this season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50380724/sources-eagles-turn-joe-milton-starting-qb-vs-giants)
- Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (quad) is ruled out for Sunday vs. the Cardinals and will be week-to-week; Drew Lock starts. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50380713/seahawks-qb-sam-darnold-ruled-quad-injury)
- Jets WR Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol a week before the trade deadline, clouding his Week 9 status. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50380113/jets-wr-wilson-protocol-rb-hall-trending-return)
- Micah Parsons returned to full Packers practice for the first time since tearing his ACL. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/green-bay-packers-micah-parsons-2026-season-debut-practice)
- Lions LB Jack Campbell says he has full movement in his lower body and is progressing in his upper body after his scary neck injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50380067/lions-lb-campbell-full-movement-lower-body-neck-injury)
- Bills released CB C.J. Gardner-Johnson just days after suspending him for a spitting incident. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bills-release-c-j-gardner-johnson-days-after-being-suspended-spitting-incident/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Tyler Huntley is out for the season with turf toe, losing their top backup while Lamar Jackson is also out. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/ravens-tyler-huntley-injury-update-turf-toe-out-for-season/)
- Cardinals placed rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (high ankle sprain) on injured reserve, the second setback of his rookie season. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/cardinals-rb-jeremiyah-love-goes-to-ir-with-high-ankle-sprain-in-another-setback)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-04 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Ravens are finalizing a trade for QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals; the deal won't be done in time for Thursday's game at Jacksonville, and he's expected to take over as starter soon after. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jacoby-brissett-ravens-trade-quarterback-cardinals-2026)
- Backup QB Tyler Huntley (turf toe) is out for the season, leaving Baltimore with Joe Fagnano as its only healthy QB until Brissett arrives. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/tyler-huntley-toe-injury-season-ending-2026)
- Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano is confirmed as Thursday night's starter at Jacksonville, with the Ravens voicing confidence in him. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-joe-fagnano-belief-quarterback-lamar-jackson-tyler-huntley)
- Rookie RG Vega Ioane (knee) has no injury designation and is set to return Thursday, boosting the offensive line. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-jaguars-injury-report-vega-ioane-nate-wiggins-bhayshul-tuten)
- CB Nate Wiggins (stinger/illness) is questionable for Thursday after missing Wednesday's walk-through. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-jaguars-injury-report-vega-ioane-nate-wiggins-bhayshul-tuten)
